description: Scan one agent skill or instruction file (SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, a tool.json, any text file) with MoorAI's open-source engine. Static analysis only; nothing is run. The text is written to a temporary directory, scanned and deleted; only its hash, the verdict and content-free findings are kept. Returns a verdict (CLEAN, CAUTION, REVIEW, DO-NOT-INSTALL or NAME-NOT-PUBLISHED), the findings and a permalink.

filename.description: The file's name, which sets how it is analysed (default SKILL.md)

name: scan_skill
title: Scan an agent skill file
